story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Identify inbound 834 business dates used by the transaction effective date logic
scenarios.descriptionRef:
Technical Notes
Data values are contained in the 834 transaction loops as follows:Assessment Date - Loop 2300, HD03
Effective Date - Loop 2000, DTP03
Maintenance Date - Loop 2000, DTP01
Adjust logic to selectively use Eligibility Date, Assessment Date, or Maintenance Date as transaction effective date based on the outlined business rules.
Ensure backward compatibility with existing EDI processing where applicable.
When multiple dates come in, use the first one.
Refer to DMND0031922.
scenarios.acceptanceCriteriaRef:
EDI is able to identify the following dates in the EDI 834 file (existing functionality): Effective Date, Assessment Date, Maintenance Date.
Enrollment IT can populate any of the three dates above into the transaction effective date in Facets (existing functionality).
scenarios.dodRef:
Transaction effective date in Facets is correctly populated per the detailed business rules and requirements.
Unit and integration tests have passed.
scenarios.description: Validate that inbound EDI 834 processing for AR PASSE identifies Eligibility Date from Loop 2000 DTP*356/DTP*348, Assessment Date from Loop 2300 HD03, and Maintenance Date from Loop 2000 DTP*303 so the transaction effective date can be populated in Facets using the correct business date source, with the first occurrence used when multiple dates of the same type are present. Conditions to cover: 1) Eligibility Date is identified from Loop 2000 DTP*356. 2) Eligibility Date is identified from Loop 2000 DTP*348. 3) Assessment Date is identified from Loop 2300 HD03. 4) Maintenance Date is identified from Loop 2000 DTP*303. 5) The first occurrence is used when multiple Eligibility Date values are present in one inbound file. 6) The first occurrence is used when multiple Maintenance Date values are present in one inbound file.

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date as the transaction effective date for new enrollment before eligibility begins
scenarios.descriptionRef:
The business needs to utilize the Eligibility Date 2000 Loop (DTP*356/DTP*348) from the EDI 834 as the transaction effective date for all new enrollments, regardless of the Assessment Date. For example: Eligibility Date = 1/31/25 and Assessment Date = 1/24/25, use Eligibility Date (1/31/25).

scenarios.description: Validate that a new enrollment inbound 834 for AR PASSE uses Eligibility Date as the transaction effective date in Facets when the member’s eligibility span has not yet begun, regardless of the Assessment Date, and that the Facets UI field 'Eligibility Date' refreshes to the winning date. Conditions to cover: 1) New enrollment uses Loop 2000 DTP*356 as the winning Eligibility Date before the span begins. 2) New enrollment uses Loop 2000 DTP*348 as the winning Eligibility Date before the span begins. 3) Assessment Date is earlier than the future Eligibility Date and Eligibility Date still wins. 4) Multiple Eligibility Date occurrences are present and the first Eligibility Date is used for the new enrollment transaction effective date.

scenarios.title: Use Assessment Date as the transaction effective date when current eligibility has an Assessment Date change
scenarios.descriptionRef:
The business needs to utilize the Assessment Date as the transaction effective date for changes to current eligibility, if the Assessment Date has changed. For example: Eligibility Date = 1/31/25 and Assessment Date changes to 6/29/25, use Assessment Date (6/29/25).
The business needs to update the Assessment Date as the transaction effective date for changes to current eligibility when the Assessment Date changes, but none of the other elements listed below have changed:Assessment Number
Assessment Tier
Assessment Division
Aid Category
Rate Cell
Pregnancy
Examples / Scenarios
ScenarioEligibility Started?Transaction Effective Date Current eligibility, Assessment Date changed Yes Assessment Date Assessment Date changed, No changes to relevant fields Yes Assessment Date

Conditions to cover: 1) Current eligibility with changed Assessment Date uses Loop 2300 HD03 as the transaction effective date. 2) Current eligibility with changed Assessment Date and unchanged relevant fields preserves the existing relevant field values while using Assessment Date. 3) Multiple Assessment Date occurrences are present and the first Assessment Date is used for the changed-Assessment-Date rule path.

scenarios.descriptionRef:

Conditions to cover: 1) Assessment Number changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 2) Assessment Tier changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 3) Assessment Division changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 4) Aid Category changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 5) Rate Cell changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 6) Pregnancy Indicator changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 7) Assessment Number + Assessment Tier + Assessment Division change while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 8) Aid Category + Rate Cell change while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 9) Pregnancy Indicator + Rate Cell change while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 10) Pregnancy Indicator + Aid Category + Rate Cell change while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 11) All relevant fields change together while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun.

scenarios.title: Use Maintenance Date for current eligibility changes when Assessment Date is unchanged and relevant fields change
scenarios.descriptionRef:
The business needs to utilize the Maintenance Date (DTP*303) as the transaction effective date for any changes to the items listed in Requirement 3 above, when the Assessment Date does NOT change, and those changes are received after the Eligibility Date.
Current State
Currently, Maintenance effective date is being used to split spans on Update files. This is causing mismatches with capitation calculations, and the Finance team is misreporting revenue.
What is Changing
The Maintenance Date 2000 Loop (DTP*303) cannot be used for all change transactions. Depending on the change, and whether it is received prior to or after the initial Eligibility Date, the transaction effective date may reflect either the Assessment Date, Eligibility Date, or Maintenance Date.
Examples / Scenarios
ScenarioEligibility Started?Transaction Effective Date Current eligibility, Changes to relevant fields, Assessment Date unchanged Yes Maintenance Date Relevant fields include Assessment Number, Assessment Tier, Assessment Division, Aid Category, Rate Cell, Pregnancy.

Conditions to cover: 1) Assessment Number changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has already begun. 2) Assessment Tier changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has already begun. 3) Assessment Division changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has already begun. 4) Aid Category changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has already begun. 5) Rate Cell changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has already begun. 6) Pregnancy Indicator changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has already begun. 7) Assessment Number + Assessment Tier + Assessment Division change while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has already begun. 8) Aid Category + Rate Cell change while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has already begun. 9) Pregnancy Indicator + Rate Cell change while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has already begun. 10) Pregnancy Indicator + Aid Category + Rate Cell change while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has already begun. 11) All relevant fields change together while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has already begun.

scenarios.description: Validate that the revised transaction effective date logic for inbound 834 updates corrects split-span dating without introducing capitation calculation differences or finance reporting inaccuracies across the story’s winning-date rule paths. Conditions to cover: 1) Eligibility Date-driven rule paths preserve correct downstream span dating for capitation and finance reporting. 2) Assessment Date-driven rule paths preserve correct downstream span dating for capitation and finance reporting. 3) Maintenance Date-driven rule paths preserve correct downstream span dating for capitation and finance reporting only where the story explicitly allows Maintenance Date.

review.feedback: Coverage of the core date-selection rules is solid, and the scenarios correctly use parameterized condition lists for relevant-field combinations, but the set still has actionable gaps and one over-collapsed regression bundle. Add explicit coverage for the first-occurrence rule for Assessment Date (and ideally confirm whether duplicate Effective/Eligibility parsing is needed only for identification vs rule execution), add a negative/edge scenario for unchanged current eligibility with no Assessment Date change and no relevant-field change so no improper date-driven update/span split occurs, add traceable coverage for backward compatibility and file-type grounding from the story/domain hints (E-prefix for new enrollments, U-prefix for changes), and split TS_008 because it merges two independent downstream validators: capitation calculations and finance reporting accuracy.
gaps: TS_008 is over-collapsed: it combines two independent validators that can fail separately—capitation calculation correctness and finance reporting accuracy—under one scenario.

Missing boundary/negative coverage for the path where eligibility has already begun, Assessment Date is unchanged, and no relevant fields changed; the set does not verify that no unnecessary transaction-effective-date update/span split is created in this no-change case.

TS_001 and TS_003 do not clearly cover the story's 'When multiple dates come in, use the first one' rule for duplicate Assessment Date values as a dedicated parsing/selection check across inbound date identification logic.
No scenario covers the story's 'Ensure backward compatibility with existing EDI processing where applicable.' requirement/consideration in a traceable way.

No scenario grounds file-type behavior from the authoritative hints: new enrollment should use E-prefix files and change/update paths should use U-prefix files; this is a story-specific setup rule missing from titles/descriptions.
strengths: Maps each main acceptance-criteria rule to at least one scenario, including negative coverage for restricting Maintenance Date usage.
Uses the domain-hint relevant fields and named groupings correctly in TS_004 and TS_005 rather than splitting them into redundant scenarios.
Traceability is generally good: acceptanceCriteriaRef values align to actual acceptance criteria or story text.
